name: Cambodia

seo.title: Cambodia travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: A practical Cambodia travel guide covering itinerary ideas, the best months to visit, cuisine, transport, budget, FAQs, and ratings.

overview:
Cambodia feels like it belongs to a bygone era, but in a good way. While the temples of Angkor Wat take you way back in time, the town of Siem Reap has an old Soviet vibe to it.

We found the Cambodian people to be earnest and endearing, which makes the tales of the genocide only 50 years ago all the more jarring.

Our stay in Cambodia was the shortest in our travels; lasting all of 48 hours. But the tranquility of the temples dilates time and leaves a lasting memory.

While Angkor Wat is worth a visit on its own, we do recommend clubbing Cambodia on a trip to one of it’s larger neighbours (Malaysia, Thailand, or Vietnam).
